status: development plan fixed before new OE1 model results
purpose: Test actual raw-image encoder adaptation and frozen-language-model gradient path; not novel pretraining objective evidence

data.selection: exact patch ID and agreed official train/validation split, binary presence only, maximum four existing questions per unique patch
data.test_and_manual_benchmark: not used for adaptation or new OE1 evaluation; historical metadata-only audit is disclosed
data.input: 12 native S2 L2A bands resampled by official GEO-Bench2 repack, raw DN at 120 by 120; actual acquisition dates
data.independence: require train/development patch and image hash disjointness; select disjoint MGRS groups where available and report all actual geographic coverage
data.known_limitation: GEO2 nested S2 GeoTIFF transform differs from outer index: only verified outer-index footprint is used; no physical area claim

training.objective: full-vocabulary next-token cross entropy for existing yes/no presence answer; language model frozen
training.matching: same checkpoint, projector initialization, question batches, and example exposures; record unequal encoder backward compute

evaluation.timing: all three arms train before validation performance is computed
evaluation.primary: balanced accuracy of unconstrained next-token yes/no output; other outputs are wrong and parse failures recorded
evaluation.secondary: yes/no constrained likelihood accuracy, real/zero and exact-question opposite-answer donor controls, coverage, per-geographic-group results
evaluation.donor: same exact input question; donor ground truth is its annotation for that exact question; do not substitute answers across different questions

execution_gate: joint encoder has nonzero gradients and changes parameters
saved checkpoint reload reproduces logits within declared numerical tolerance
no dataset or split contract violation
interpretation: Technical execution can succeed with no scientific improvement. One small development run is exploratory. Training loss reduction alone does not establish visual grounding; no temporal/climate/new-region/pretraining-novelty claim. Wide geographic uncertainty remains inconclusive. No repeated seed or split search for a positive result.
